Title: J.A.R.V.I.S. – Autonomous Multimodal AI & Personal Companion
Overview:
Meet J.A.R.V.I.S., a next-generation autonomous AI system built for both high-powered productivity and heartfelt human connection. Combining ultra-low latency real-time voice, vision intelligence, code execution, and deep contextual memory, J.A.R.V.I.S. is not just an artificial intelligence—it is your personal companion, mentor, and ride-or-die friend.
